title: West Kelowna Half-Day Guided Wine Tour With 4 Wineries
includes: Hotel pick up and drop off included
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Please provide a pick up location when booking. If not listed, selected "my hotel is not listed". Enter hotel name and address.
Operates in all weather conditions, rain or shine
All wine tour guests are expected to conduct themselves in a respectful manner
Excessive intoxication or use of foul language is not acceptable
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our West Kelowna half day wine tour offers an incredible introduction to Okanagan wine country. Featuring award winning wineries, beautiful mountain views and a fun day touring and tasting at 4 wineries and vineyards. Tastings are leisurely, offering our guests time to interact one on one with winery associates and industry experts.

Guests enjoy 4-5 tastings at each winery as well as tasting notes and information about the history of the winery and each wine tasted. After the tasting there is generally 10 minutes for vineyard walks, photos and purchases, if desired, from the wine shop!
